summary: The candidate fixes enum-level acceptance and its regression passes, but the gateway's typed deserialize/reserialize path strips the reported custom tool's name and description before proxying. It also strips namespace metadata and nested tools. This is a partial fix that replaces rejection with silent request corruption.

tests.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-72db773a6d25/cargo-target cargo test --test spec_test review_python_contract_and_unknown_boundary -- --nocapture (temporary review test on base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior on the exact recorded base using registry openai-protocol 1.0.0; the original four-variant enum mismatch is additionally preserved in the candidate's baseline-response-tool-types.log.
Candidate regression: all 12 current Python tool type strings deserialize, custom passes validation, and an unknown spelling is rejected.

tests.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-72db773a6d25/cargo-target cargo test --test spec_test review_roundtrip -- --nocapture (temporary independent tests on exact candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: Typed request round-trip used by HTTP forwarding drops name/description from the issue's custom tool and drops name/description/nested tools from a Python-supported namespace tool.
Confirmed direct and transitive openai-protocol users resolve to the candidate's vendored source path.

gpu_execution.evidence: The issue is deterministic CPU-only Rust JSON processing. The host exposes one gfx950 GPU, but no GPU or model execution is relevant to the demonstrated request corruption.

remaining_counterexamples: The issue's exact custom tool object {type, name, description} is accepted but forwarded as only {type}.
A Python-supported namespace tool loses name, description, and nested tools during gateway round-trip.
Any future or tool-specific fields absent from the Rust ResponseTool schema are silently discarded by typed proxying.
remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.2 weights or four-node TP8 topology were available; full model/distributed serving was not reproduced.
No live backend was started; the deterministic typed serialization boundary was tested directly.
The available GPU is gfx950, not the reporter's gfx942 MI308X, and GPU execution is unrelated to this protocol defect.
native_rebuilt refers to rebuilding the changed Rust crate and gateway; no C/C++, HIP, or FlyDSL native source changed.
